# discord_webhook (Resource)

Manages a Discord webhook.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_id` (String) The channel ID to create the webhook in.
- `name` (String) The name of the webhook (1-80 characters).

### Optional

- `avatar_data_uri` (String) The avatar data URI for the webhook (data:image/...;base64,...).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the webhook.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The webhook token.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) The full webhook URL including the token.
